offence_note: Six counts of sexual assault on a 6-year-old by a young person
sentence_quote: The court orders that there be a six-month deferred custody term imposed in relation to each charge, to be served concurrently with each other.
note: Youth deferred custody and supervision order recorded as conditional sentence; 2-year s.51(3) prohibition.

offence_note: Robbery of woman at bank machine; resisting arrest counts sent to new trial
sentence_quote: On the robbery charge (bearing in mind the three years and eight months spent in custody), I would impose a sentence of one day.
note: NCRMD verdict set aside; appeal court itself sentences robbery; new trial on resisting arrest.

offence_note: Two counts of manslaughter by stabbing
sentence_quote: I have concluded that an effective global sentence of 11 years will balance the principles of denunciation and general deterrence with the principle of rehabilitation
note: Credit is 16 months at two-for-one; further 8.5 years concurrent on each count.

offence_note: Unlawful confinement, extortion, assault causing bodily harm
sentence_quote: the appeal is allowed to the extent of reducing the sentence to three years, 241 days in addition to the credit of 306 days.
note: Summers 1.5:1 credit appeal by consent; prison total computed as 3y 241d plus 306d credit.

sentence_quote: the court sentences you to a term of imprisonment of two (2) years’ incarceration in a federal institution which is a bare-minimum federal sentence.
note: Joint recommendation accepted; 20-year SOIRA, 10-year s.161 order.

offence_note: Robbery of pharmacy with imitation firearm; weapons offences
sentence_quote: Having weighed all of the relevant factors, I determine a fit and proper sentence to be 28 months imprisonment for the offence of robbery.
note: Cultural assessment gave context but did not diminish responsibility; father has Aboriginal ancestry mentioned only.

offence_note: Conspiracy to extort, extortion, kidnapping, confinement, vehicle theft
sentence_quote: while leave to appeal sentence is granted, I would dismiss the sentence appeal.
note: Majority dismisses; Armstrong J.A. dissent ignored. Four-year extortion term consecutive to unrelated sentence.

offence_note: Theft of motor vehicle; breach of undertaking conviction quashed
sentence_quote: The appellant, therefore, must serve a sentence of 24 months, less 4 months credit, for a total of 20 months beginning on July 20, 2006.
note: Theft sentence stands; separate four-month breach sentence vacated.

offence_note: Offences not shown; two offences with consecutive sentences argued
sentence_quote: the global sentence of 18 months imposed by the trial judge was, for this offender, not demonstrably unfit.
note: Crown appeal dismissed; form of 18-month sentence and offences not shown.

offence_note: Sexual assault and assault of intimate acquaintance
sentence_quote: The Court orders that the combined sentences of two years less a day be served in the community under the terms of a CSO
note: Conditional sentence for sexual assault; 20-year SOIRA; 30 days concurrent for assault.
